pages.title: Matured Antibody
pages.text: An antibody bred over many rounds of selection, each round keeping only the clones that bind best, until it fits its target a thousand times more tightly. Made in the Clonal Selector.

Made in $(item)Clonal Selector$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Affinity Maturation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Lasting Fracture Ward, Lasting Grey Goo Ward, Lasting Hollowing Ward, Lasting Metastasis Ward, Lasting Rewind Ward, Metastasis Ward.
